product.description: Descoperă pictogramele și începe să citești cu ajutor! Ascultă povestea pe care părintele tău o citește cu voce tare și participă la lectură rostind cuvintele reprezentate prin imagini. În felul acesta vei urmări mai ușor firul poveștii, iar lectura va deveni una dintre activitățile tale preferate.   Această serie cu pictograme: • încurajează și dezvoltă abilitățile de citire. • este perfectă pentru momentele împreună cu cel mic. • este ideală ca poveste de seară, dar și pentru orice moment al zilei.   Prima mea lectură este o colecție special creată pentru a-i ghida pas cu pas pe preșcolari și pe școlari în aventura cititului. Formatul accesibil, textele ilustrate și adaptate la nivelul de înțelegere al vârstei, succesul de care se bucură aceste cărți în lumea întreagă și premiile primite îi motivează pe copii să-și cultive interesul pentru lectură. # The Bunny and the Fox: A Pictogram Storybook for Beginner Readers (Level 1)

Empower your child's journey into literacy with the *Bunny and the Fox* story, an engaging resource designed to make reading a joyful activity. This Level 1 book from Litera utilizes colorful pictograms to guide young learners step-by-step through the basics of reading. Perfect for pre-schoolers and early readers, this interactive story transforms vocabulary recognition into a fun family experience.

## Why Pictogram Storybooks Are Ideal for Early Readers

Our series helps bridge the gap between looking at pictures and understanding written text. Instead of just following words, children interact with pictogramsâimages that represent the wordsâallowing them to follow the narrative thread easily.

When using this book:
*   **Interactive Learning:** The parent reads the story aloud, while your child actively participates by "reading" the words represented by the images.
*   **Boosted Comprehension:** By linking visual cues with written text, children develop a stronger understanding of plot and vocabulary.
*   **Confidence Builder:** This accessible format builds reading confidence gradually, ensuring that the process remains fun rather than frustrating.

## A Comprehensive Reading Journey: Litera Educational Levels

This isn't just a single story; it's the first step in a highly successful and award-winning educational series created specifically to guide children through literacy. The entire collection is designed for progressive learning, adapting its complexity as your child grows.

*   **Level 1:** Perfect for ages 5â6 years (Ideal starting point).
*   **Level 2 & Level 3:** For ages 6â7 years.
*   **Level 4:** For ages 7â8 years.
*   **Level 5 & Level 6:** For ages 8â9 years.

The adaptable, illustrated texts ensure that whether itâs a quiet evening story or an energetic learning session, the content is perfectly matched to your child's developmental level.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for children who are just starting to read?**
A: Yes. Level 1 is specifically designed for pre-schoolers and young children (ages 5â6). The pictogram format provides the necessary scaffolding to make early reading engaging and manageable.

**Q: How do I use this book with my child?**
A: This book is best used interactively. Have a parent read the story aloud, pausing frequently so your child can point to and "read" the words represented by the accompanying images.
